welcome_desc: Record your screen and get a polished video, with zooms that follow your cursor.
about_desc: So we can reply when you send feedback from the app.
productUpdates: Email me product updates and tips
permissions_desc: macOS asks once. Screenforge only records when you press Record.
permissions_pendingDesc: macOS turns screen recording on after Screenforge reopens. You'll come back right here.
permissions_backDesc: Screen recording is on. Pick up where you left off.
screen_turnOnDesc: Turn on Screenforge in System Settings, then reopen
prefs_desc: You can change these any time in Settings.
prefs_saveFailed: Couldn't save your preferences. Try again.
record_desc: Pick a display, window or area, then press Record. Zooms are added for you.
record_ffmpegDesc: Screenforge needs FFmpeg to save videos. This only happens once.
record_ffmpegFailedDesc: Check your connection and try again. You can still look around the editor.
scene_screenRecordingCaption: Allow the apps below to record your screen.
